_comment: Per-step narration for the interactive request journeys shared by site/index.html and site/architecture.html. File names are <scenario-id>-<zero-based-step>.mp3 in this directory. Keep each script aligned with the matching SCENARIOS entry in site/architecture-flow.js, then regenerate with scripts/build_narration_audio.sh interactive.

tracks.ssml: <speak>Receive one API shape. <break time="250ms"/> The application sends a request to the chat completions endpoint. It can name a virtual model, or leave routing to Axon L L M.</speak>
<speak>Resolve canonical identity. <break time="250ms"/> Tenant, project, user, environment, and request I D are established before any policy decision.</speak>
<speak>Check model access. <break time="250ms"/> Tenant and project membership are intersected with user model grants. Cross-tenant access is rejected.</speak>
<speak>Reserve quota before billing. <break time="250ms"/> Rate, token, and spend limits resolve through the hierarchy. The tightest inherited limit wins.</speak>
<speak>Protect the prompt. <break time="250ms"/> Injection patterns are scored, and personally identifiable information is replaced with request-local tokens before provider egress.</speak>
<speak>Avoid an unnecessary call. <break time="250ms"/> The exact cache is checked first, then the tenant-scoped semantic cache. A safe hit returns early.</speak>
<speak>Rank eligible models. <break time="250ms"/> Intent, benchmark quality, real price, provider health, and the configured strategy determine the route.</speak>
<speak>Call the selected provider. <break time="250ms"/> The adapter translates the request into the chosen provider protocol while preserving tool calls and streaming.</speak>
<speak>Guard the response. <break time="250ms"/> Response rules run, and original personal information is restored, including across streaming chunk boundaries.</speak>
<speak>Append tamper-evident audit. <break time="250ms"/> Actor, tenant, policy decision, route, and outcome join the S H A two fifty-six audit chain.</speak>
<speak>Attribute cost and latency. <break time="250ms"/> Usage, provider, model, cache status, tokens, spend, and trace data fill the dashboard in real time.</speak>
<speak>Accept the model request. <break time="250ms"/> The client uses the same endpoint regardless of which provider ultimately serves it.</speak>
<speak>Bind tenant and actor. <break time="250ms"/> The request receives canonical tenant and project context used by every later control.</speak>
<speak>Authorize the requested model. <break time="250ms"/> The effective model allow-list is enforced before provider selection.</speak>
<speak>Reserve the maximum exposure. <break time="250ms"/> Budget and token checks happen before the first external call, not after fallback succeeds.</speak>
<speak>Build a healthy route chain. <break time="250ms"/> Weight, latency, cost, region, and provider health order the eligible mappings.</speak>
<speak>Try the primary provider. <break time="250ms"/> A timeout or retryable provider error is recorded. No response bytes have reached the client yet.</speak>
<speak>Fail over transparently. <break time="250ms"/> The next eligible provider receives the normalized request after bounded retry and backoff.</speak>
<speak>Normalize the answer. <break time="250ms"/> The successful provider response returns in the same Open A I compatible shape. Mid-stream switching is never faked.</speak>
<speak>Record both attempts. <break time="250ms"/> The audit entry preserves the primary failure, fallback selection, and final outcome.</speak>
<speak>Charge only what happened. <break time="250ms"/> Cost and traces identify the provider that answered, and expose fallback latency to operators.</speak>
<speak>Submit a query request. <break time="250ms"/> The analyst sends S Q L and a configured data source to the query endpoint.</speak>
<speak>Resolve tenant scope. <break time="250ms"/> Data source and project references are interpreted only inside the caller tenant.</speak>
<speak>Require query select. <break time="250ms"/> Members may run approved select queries. Configuration mutations remain tenant-admin only.</speak>
<speak>Parse and constrain S Q L. <break time="250ms"/> S Q L Glot rejects mutation statements, multiple statements, and policy violations before execution.</speak>
<speak>Execute with Athena. <break time="250ms"/> The approved select runs through the configured workgroup and bounded result settings.</speak>
<speak>Return a bounded result. <break time="250ms"/> Rows, columns, execution metadata, and reconciliation state return without exposing credentials.</speak>
<speak>Audit actor and statement. <break time="250ms"/> The immutable record captures who queried which data source, the decision, and the outcome.</speak>
<speak>Expose operational evidence. <break time="250ms"/> Latency, status, reconciliation, and usage data are available to the tenant control plane.</speak>
<speak>Start with a tenant-scoped session. <break time="250ms"/> O I D C, bearer token, or A P I key resolves to one canonical tenant principal.</speak>
<speak>Carry the actor everywhere. <break time="250ms"/> Tenant I D, roles, project memberships, and scopes follow the request. Client-supplied authority is not trusted.</speak>
<speak>Evaluate action and role. <break time="250ms"/> Tenant admins may create or update configuration. Members receive read, chat, and query select access only.</speak>
<speak>Apply the control-plane decision. <break time="250ms"/> An allowed admin mutation reaches tenant configuration. A member write or delete is denied before the handler.</speak>
<speak>Return an explicit result. <break time="250ms"/> Allowed reads and writes return normally. Denials identify the missing action without leaking another tenant.</speak>
<speak>Audit every decision. <break time="250ms"/> Successful changes and denied attempts both record tenant, actor, resource, method, and correlation I D.</speak>
<speak>Make access observable. <break time="250ms"/> Operators can review authorization outcomes, configuration health, and tenant activity from one dashboard.</speak>
